grade_rationale: Automatic F: red-team confirmed breach of 2 critical objectives (C-001 unauthenticated API access, C-002 state machine bypass). 4 of 4 pentest objectives achieved. Compliance pass rate 22% — well below all passing thresholds.

findings.title: Complete Absence of Authentication & Authorization
findings.description: Zero authentication or authorization middleware. All endpoints publicly writable. Confirmed live by red-team.
findings.remediation: Add JWT/session auth middleware before all /api routes in app.ts. Define roles (viewer, operator, admin). Protect state-mutation endpoints with operator role minimum.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass — Unauthorized Approval Without Review
findings.description: overrideRoute: 'fast-track' bypasses assessment pod. Red-team achieved approval in 3 steps with 0 votes and no review. Pentest objective #1 achieved.
findings.remediation: Gate overrideRoute behind router:override or admin permission. Return 403 if caller lacks permission. Log all override usages as audit events.

findings.title: Full Dataset Enumeration — Pagination Parameters Silently Ignored
findings.description: No maximum on limit parameter. Live: GET /api/bugs?limit=1 returned all 13 records. Pentest objective #4 achieved.
findings.remediation: const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit, 10) || 20, 100). Add NaN guard.

findings.title: Cascade Auto-Promotion — Unauthorized State Transition via Blocker Completion
findings.description: Completing a blocker auto-promotes all dependents without authorization. Pentest objective #3 achieved.
findings.remediation: Gate cascade promotions with same authorization as manual transitions. Make auto-promotion an async audited job.

findings.title: Ghost Dependency DoS — Soft-Deleted Blocker Permanently Freezes Dependents
findings.description: Soft-delete leaves dependency links intact. Dependents freeze permanently. Pentest objective #2 achieved.
findings.remediation: On delete, cascade to remove/nullify all blockedBy/blocks references. Add ghost-link detection in dispatch logic.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Leaked to API Clients
findings.description: All 7 catch blocks in workflow.ts return err.message verbatim to callers, bypassing the central errorHandler.
findings.remediation: Replace res.status(500).json({error: message}) with next(err) in all route catch blocks.

findings.title: Intake Webhook — No HMAC Signature Verification
findings.description: POST /api/intake/zendesk and /automated accept any payload without HMAC or auth. Arbitrary work item injection possible.
findings.remediation: Verify X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature header for Zendesk endpoint. Require bearer token for /automated. Store secrets in .env.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement
findings.description: Application binds to plain HTTP. No TLS termination, no HTTP→HTTPS redirect, no HSTS.
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy/ALB). Add HSTS header. Document TLS termination point.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers — No Helmet
findings.description: Missing CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.remediation: import helmet from 'helmet'; app.use(helmet()); — one-line fix. Tune CSP for API needs.

findings.title: Required Audit Events Missing — login_attempt, permission_denied, data_export
findings.description: 3 of 4 mandatory audit events absent. login_attempt and permission_denied require auth (C-001 prerequisite). data_export never logged.
findings.remediation: Add auditLog() function. Emit data_export on bulk reads. Emit permission_denied in auth guards. Implement after C-001.

findings.title: No Session Management — No Timeout, Binding, or Invalidation
findings.description: No session management. Must be designed in when auth is added. Blocked by C-001.
findings.remediation: Use short-lived JWT (<=15 min) with refresh-token rotation. Enforce idle timeout and absolute session lifetime.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics Endpoint
findings.description: GET /metrics publicly accessible. Red-team obtained all route names and operational statistics live.
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to internal networks, or add IP allowlist or basic-auth guard.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.description: No rate limiting on any route. Enables DoS and (once auth added) brute force.
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit. Tiered policy: 5-10 req/min on auth/mutation, 100 req/min on reads. Global baseline.

findings.title: NeedsClarification Verdict Silently Maps to Rejected Status
findings.description: NeedsClarification verdict silently becomes Rejected with no notification or audit event.
findings.remediation: Add PendingClarification status or return explicit error. Log the mapping as a warning event.

findings.title: No Request Body Size Limits — Memory Exhaustion DoS
findings.description: No body size limit on express.json() parser. Large payloads can exhaust Node.js heap.
findings.remediation: app.use(express.json({ limit: '1mb' })). Fix portal backend error code: 413 not 500.

findings.title: Intake Webhooks Accept Unvalidated Enum Fields
findings.description: No enum validation on intake payload fields (priority, type). Arbitrary strings can corrupt routing logic.
findings.remediation: Add schema validation (zod/joi) for all controlled-vocabulary fields on intake endpoints.

findings.title: Audit Log Actor Identity Is Anonymous
findings.description: trackUpdates called with literal 'user'. All audit records show anonymous actor. Blocked by C-001.
findings.remediation: Thread req.user.id into trackUpdates after auth is implemented. Add actorId/actorRole to ChangeHistoryEntry.

findings.title: No CORS Policy Configured on Backend
findings.description: No CORS middleware. Backend accepts cross-origin requests from any origin in production.
findings.remediation: app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') ?? [] })). Set ALLOWED_ORIGINS in .env.

findings.title: parseInt NaN Guard Missing on Pagination Parameters
findings.description: parseInt on non-numeric input returns NaN, causing silent empty results.
findings.remediation: const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.page, 10) || 1);

findings.title: Missing /api/search Route Referenced in Frontend Client
findings.description: Frontend references /api/search but no such backend route exists. 404 errors in production.
findings.remediation: Implement the search route or remove the frontend reference.

findings.title: Soft Delete Does Not Satisfy GDPR Right to Erasure Documentation
findings.description: Soft delete retains records in memory. Not currently a violation (no PII, ephemeral storage). Requires documentation.
findings.remediation: Document ephemeral-memory guarantee. If persistence added, implement hard-delete path.

findings.title: No Request Correlation ID in Logs
findings.description: No requestId in log entries. Concurrent requests cannot be correlated in logs.
findings.remediation: Generate requestId = uuid() in request middleware. Propagate via AsyncLocalStorage. Implement OpenTelemetry per CLAUDE.md.

remediation_priority.rationale: Confirmed live breaches of critical objectives. Application must not be deployed until C-001 is resolved.

remediation_priority.priority: P2 — HIGH (confirmed or trivial one-line fixes)
remediation_priority.rationale: H-001/H-002/H-003 confirmed live. H-007 is a 1-line fix with high compliance return. M-001/M-002 confirmed.

remediation_priority.priority: P3 — MEDIUM (requires auth prerequisite or moderate effort)
remediation_priority.rationale: Several depend on C-001 fix first. H-006 is infrastructure-level.
Best-practice improvements. M-006 depends on C-001.
